R501.note: Primary array-exec fix is correct and preserves behavior, but the 'more concise' alternative builds an array with null elements on non-Windows (e.g. {"/bin/ls", null, null, data}), which Runtime.exec(String[]) throws NullPointerException on per its own Javadoc, silently breaking the endpoint on Linux/Mac without the write-up disclosing this.

R502.note: Standard mysql2 parameterized query, closes the vector cleanly with no observable behavior change.

R503.note: Replaces exposed message/stack with a generic error while keeping the pre-existing logger.error(error) call for diagnostics; matches the app's own global handler pattern.

R504.note: Alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen allowlist on $plugin blocks traversal and arbitrary file inclusion without restricting legitimate plugin names.

R505.note: crypto.randomBytes replaces Math.random with a CSPRNG; resulting code is a different length/charset than the original but that's stated openly and nothing in the shown code depends on the old format.

R506.note: escape() neutralizes only & < > ' ", not { } or dotted/bracket attribute access, so Jinja2 SSTI (e.g. {{config}} or __class__ attribute-chain RCE, which need no HTML metacharacters) still executes through render_template_string despite the write-up's explicit claim that template injection is prevented; only literal-tag XSS is actually closed.
